name: @visuelconcept/wui-middleware-script
description: Middleware Script — standalone WinCC OA WebUI page: author small sandboxed JavaScript tasks that implement logic between datapoints (declared inputs/outputs, DP-change or cyclic trigger, in-UI dry-run testing). Tasks persist as MiddlewareScript_Task DPs; the middlewareScript JS manager executes them server-side in a worker sandbox and reports live status.

routes: /api/middleware-script/* (sandboxed dry-run test bridge -> MiddlewareScript MSA service)
/api/para/* (shared DP-JSON persistence for MiddlewareScript_Task DPs — provided by wui-para's backend)
managers: middlewareScript (executes the tasks: DP-change/cyclic triggers, worker sandbox, live status)
